title: The connector is never the person to reply to

objects.subject: Arjun <> Farah Qureshi (Kitepath)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Farah Qureshi, who leads investments at Kitepath. Farah, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly
